message.content:
The most critically acclaimed film released in 2020 was **“Nomadland.”**  
It went on to win the Academy Award for Best Picture and received widespread praise for its intimate storytelling, strong performances—especially Frances McDormand—and its contemplative exploration of modern American life. While other notable releases that year included “Tenet,” “Soul,” and “The Trial of the Chicago 7,” “Nomadland” is generally regarded as the standout film of 2020.
